clue.text: Deft men retreating into mine entrance

indicators.note: into says the backward soldiers are placed inside the mine's way in

parts.note: an adit is a horizontal entrance tunnel to a mine

indicators.note: retreating means the word for the men goes backwards

parts.note: OR, other ranks, is the usual abbreviation for soldiers who are not officers

explanation.surface: Skilled miners pull back into the mouth of the pit.
explanation.walkthrough: 'retreating' turns OR into RO, and 'into' places that inside ADIT.
explanation.definitionFit: A straightforward synonym: someone deft is nimble and skilful with their hands.

clue.text: Waist's let out, reportedly, by one sort of trousers

definitions.meaning: said aloud, waist sounds like waste, and waste is let out by a pipe for drainage

explanation.surface: A waistband is loosened on a pair of trousers.
explanation.walkthrough: 'reportedly' tells us 'waist' is heard as 'waste', and waste is let out by a drainpipe.
explanation.definitionFit: Drainpipes were the skinny trousers favoured by 1950s Teddy boys, named for their narrow tube shape.

clue.text: Prayer for star eclipsing sun

indicators.note: eclipsing suggests one body covering another, so the star constellation encloses the letter

parts.note: Orion is a constellation, loosely a star

explanation.surface: A prayer asks for a celestial body to block out the sun.
explanation.walkthrough: 'eclipsing' puts S inside ORION.
explanation.definitionFit: Orison is an archaic, literary word for a prayer.

clue.text: Religious structure presented to another, with nothing inside

parts.note: taken as written

indicators.note: inside means zero is placed within the other religious building

parts.note: another religious structure, here a temple
O looks like zero, nothing

explanation.surface: One religious building is given to another, empty inside.
explanation.walkthrough: 'another' refers back to the definition: a second religious structure, TEMPLE.
explanation.definitionFit: A carved totem pole has spiritual and ancestral meaning for peoples of the Pacific Northwest.

clue.text: Prison officer coming back to pick another ticket

indicators.note: coming back tells us to read the officer's title from end to start

parts.note: a warder is a guard in a prison

explanation.surface: A returning jail guard enters a lottery a second time.
explanation.walkthrough: 'coming back' turns WARDER into REDRAW.
explanation.definitionFit: To pull a lottery number or ticket a second time is literally to draw again.

clue.text: Product of sap to go wrong again?

parts.note: the prefix re- means again
to sin is to go wrong morally

explanation.surface: A fool's output might be to transgress a second time.
explanation.walkthrough: 'sap' looks like a fool but is tree juice; RE plus SIN is to sin again.
explanation.definitionFit: Tree sap hardens into the sticky substance used in varnish and amber.

clue.text: Date made off with purchase from shambles

indicators.note: off means the letters have gone bad and are rearranged

explanation.surface: A dated item made off with something bought in a mess.
explanation.walkthrough: 'shambles' is an old word for a slaughterhouse or meat market, not a mess; 'off' mixes DATE MADE.
explanation.definitionFit: Flesh bought from a butcher's market is the meat of a slaughtered animal.

clue.text: Like a winger, one in a vehicle

indicators.note: in places the numeral within the vehicle

parts.note: a van is a vehicle
I is the Roman numeral one

explanation.surface: A footballer on the wing travels in a vehicle.
explanation.walkthrough: 'winger' suggests football, but here it is anything with wings.
explanation.definitionFit: Avian means relating to birds, the winged creatures.

clue.text: Poet putting priests in first

indicators.note: in places the priests inside the abbreviated ordinal

parts.note: 1st, written IST in crossword style, abbreviates first
the Magi were the priestly caste of ancient Persia

explanation.surface: A poet puts clergy at the head of the queue.
explanation.walkthrough: 'first' is 1ST, read as the letters IST; 'in' puts MAGI inside it.
explanation.definitionFit: Imagists were early twentieth-century writers of verse, such as Ezra Pound, who favoured clear, precise images.

clue.text: Shy dog races round, having eaten topless outside

indicators.note: outside means the trimmed meal word wraps around the rest
topless removes the first letter, the top of a down entry

parts.note: having eaten is to have dined

indicators.note: round means the race letters encircle the dog

parts.note: TT, Tourist Trophy, is the Isle of Man motorcycle races
Rover is a stock dog's name

explanation.surface: A timid dog runs round after a meal, half-naked outdoors.
explanation.walkthrough: 'round' puts ROVER in TT; 'topless' makes DINED into INED, and 'outside' wraps it around TROVERT.
explanation.definitionFit: A shy, reserved person turned inward is the classic retiring type.

clue.text: Supply information about organ that's hot

indicators.note: about means the informer's verb is wrapped around the organ

parts.note: to sing is slang for informing to the police
the ear is an organ of hearing

explanation.surface: Someone passes on information concerning an organ that is running hot.
explanation.walkthrough: 'about' puts SING around EAR.
explanation.definitionFit: Something searing is scorchingly hot, enough to burn.

clue.text: Bon vivant given introduction to Galileo Galilei, maybe

indicators.note: introduction to takes the opening letter of the name

parts.note: Galileo Galilei was an astronomer, an example so maybe

explanation.surface: A lover of good living is introduced to the great Italian scientist.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Galileo Galilei' reads as one name but splits: G from Galileo, then Galilei as an example of a stargazer.
explanation.definitionFit: A bon vivant enjoys good food and drink, as a gourmet or gastronome does.

clue.text: Religious code of Butterfly State gets guys encamped

indicators.note: gets here means the shelters take in the pieces, as a camp gets its occupants

parts.note: encamped means lodged in canvas shelters, so it stands for tents, the container
the comma is a British butterfly
ND abbreviates North Dakota, a US state
guys means men

explanation.surface: A butterfly and a nation's laws mingle with men camping out.
explanation.walkthrough: 'encamped' stands for 'in tents': with 'gets' as the joining word, COMMA, ND (North Dakota) and MEN are lodged inside.
explanation.definitionFit: The Ten Commandments are the moral code given to Moses, central to Jewish and Christian teaching.

clue.text: Getting on, secured one's rank

indicators.note: secured means the word for aged holds the numeral inside it

parts.note: someone getting on is old
I is the Roman numeral one

explanation.surface: An older person has locked in their position in the hierarchy.
explanation.walkthrough: 'rank' here is smelly, not a position; 'secured' puts I inside OLD.
explanation.definitionFit: Olid is a rare word for foul-smelling, the adjective sense of rank.

clue.text: Something in the wardrobe provoking fury after child's first expletive

indicators.note: after puts the fury at the end, behind the initial and the swear word
first picks the opening letter of the child's word

parts.note: an oath is a swear word
provoking fury, here taken as anger itself

explanation.surface: A child's first swear word causes a fit of rage among the clothes.
explanation.walkthrough: 'first' takes C from child's; 'after' puts the fury behind the swear word. 'Something in the wardrobe' is deliberately vague.
explanation.definitionFit: A wire or wooden frame for hanging garments is a typical item kept in a closet.

clue.text: Heavy drinker snaffling Scandinavian funds on time? It's not proven

indicators.note: snaffling means grabbing, so the drinker takes the money inside

parts.note: a theic is one who drinks too much tea

indicators.note: on means the money comes before the time letter, sitting on top of it in this down entry

parts.note: ore are coins of Sweden, Denmark and Norway

explanation.surface: A boozer steals Nordic cash on time, though nothing can be proven.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Heavy drinker' suggests alcohol but THEIC is an excessive tea drinker; 'snaffling' puts ORE then T inside it.
explanation.definitionFit: Something only in theory has been reasoned about but never demonstrated in practice.

clue.text: Rubbish opera, La Gioconda, initially upset combatant

indicators.note: upset in a down entry means the letters are turned upside down, read bottom to top

parts.note: rot is rubbish, nonsense
Aida is the Verdi opera

indicators.note: initially takes the opening letters of the two words

explanation.surface: A trashy opera, La Gioconda, is overturned by a fighter.
explanation.walkthrough: 'upset' reverses ROTAIDALG, which is ROT, AIDA and LG.
explanation.definitionFit: Gladiators fought in Roman arenas, so a gladiator is a fighter.

clue.text: Dependable cooking salt applied to growth

indicators.note: cooking means the letters are being prepared into a new form

parts.note: a wart is a small growth on the skin

explanation.surface: Reliable cooking salt is put on a growth.
explanation.walkthrough: 'cooking' mixes SALT into STAL.
explanation.definitionFit: A stalwart is loyal and reliable, someone who can be depended upon.

clue.text: Insertions into headless French right-winger's works of scholarship

indicators.note: headless means the politician's surname loses its first letter

parts.note: Le Pen is the surname of the French far-right politicians Jean-Marie and Marine
theses are academic dissertations

explanation.surface: Insertions in the academic writings of a beheaded French politician.
explanation.walkthrough: 'headless' cuts LEPEN to EPEN, then THESES follows.
explanation.definitionFit: In phonetics, an epenthesis is the insertion of an extra sound into a word, as in 'athalete'.

clue.text: Veer to north and look ready for bed

parts.note: to yaw is to veer off course, of a ship or aircraft
N is the compass abbreviation for north

explanation.surface: Turn north and look sleepy.
explanation.definitionFit: Opening one's mouth wide in tiredness is the classic sign that someone is sleepy.

clue.text: Cost of performer in panto receiving silver

indicators.note: receiving means the performer takes in the metal

parts.note: the pantomime dame is a man playing a comic old woman in a British Christmas show
Ag is the chemical symbol for silver

explanation.surface: A pantomime actor receives silver as their fee.
explanation.walkthrough: 'receiving' puts AG inside DAME; pantomime is a British Christmas stage show.
explanation.definitionFit: Asking 'what's the damage?' is an informal way to ask the cost or price.

clue.text: Revolutionary 1 24 or not, Mao and Stalin engaged in it

definitions.text: Revolutionary 1 24 or not, Mao and Stalin engaged in it

indicators.note: revolutionary means the letters are turned about into a new order

parts.note: I is the Roman numeral for one

indicators.note: not says the word or is to be absent from the clue at 24

parts.note: the answer to 24 across, a betrayer
taken as written

explanation.surface: Whether revolutionary or treacherous, Mao and Stalin both practised a political system.
explanation.walkthrough: '1' is read as the numeral I, not a clue number; 24 without 'or' is TRAIT. 'Revolutionary' mixes I, TRAIT, MAO and STALIN.
explanation.definitionFit: The whole clue describes a regime of total state control, as practised by Mao and Stalin.

clue.text: Suspicion of discrimination

definitions.meaning: a suspicion of something is a small trace or hint of it
discrimination here means discernment, good judgement in aesthetic matters

explanation.surface: A hint of prejudice.
explanation.definitionFit: A taste of something is just a trace, and good judgement in style is also called having taste.

clue.text: Clipped end of secret language

indicators.note: end of takes the final letter of secret

parts.note: Erse is the Gaelic language of Scotland or Ireland

explanation.surface: The last of a code language cut short.
explanation.definitionFit: Clipped speech is brief and curt, using few words.

clue.text: Turned free to shroud recess in gloom

indicators.note: turned means the whole assembly is read back to front
to shroud means to wrap around, so the word for free encloses the recess

parts.note: to rid is to free
an apse is a recess in a church

explanation.surface: A freed person wraps a niche in darkness.
explanation.walkthrough: 'to shroud' puts APSE inside RID to make RIAPSED, and 'Turned' reverses that.
explanation.definitionFit: Hopelessness and deep gloom are close synonyms for a dark state of mind.

clue.text: Characteristic yellow rat

parts.note: a trait is a characteristic
or is the heraldic word for gold or yellow

explanation.surface: A cowardly rodent is described as typical.
explanation.walkthrough: 'yellow' looks like cowardice describing the rat, but it is heraldic OR.
explanation.definitionFit: Calling someone a rat means they are a betrayer who has turned on their friends.

clue.text: Drum that may contain seafood?

definitions.meaning: short for a kettledrum, a timpano
the question mark admits the stretch

explanation.surface: A drum with fish inside it.
explanation.definitionFit: Kettledrum is the full name of the orchestral drum, and fish proverbially come in a kettle.

clue.text: Toast, or something to put on it, mostly containing trace of rennet

indicators.note: containing means the shortened topping holds the single letter
mostly means the topping loses its last letter

parts.note: cheese is something to put on toast

indicators.note: trace of takes just the opening letter of rennet

explanation.surface: Toast, or its topping, made with a little rennet.
explanation.walkthrough: 'it' is toast as in bread; 'mostly' trims CHEESE to CHEES, then R goes in.
explanation.definitionFit: Saying the word when glasses are raised is how a toast to someone is drunk.
